t: Strong and reliable, heavy duty plasterboard fixings that only require a 7mm cavity. For dependable use when hanging heavy objects including radiators, cupboards, TV brackets and shelves. For use on any type of plasterboard, including stud, dot and dab and insulated (12.5-16mm). Features smart wing design that hooks behind the plasterboard. Easy to install in 5 simple steps. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
b: Suitable for Hanging Radiators, Kitchen Cabinets & TV Mounting
